messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I was sitting in my bed just typing on my laptop.

output.original_text: I was sitting in my bed just typing on my laptop.
output.joy: I was sitting in my cozy bed, happily typing away on my laptop!
output.sadness: I was sitting in my bed, alone, typing on my laptop, feeling a little empty inside.
output.fear: I was sitting in my bed, typing on my laptop, feeling an uneasy chill in the room.
output.anger: I was sitting in my bed, furiously typing on my laptop, upset at everything around me.
output.surprise: I was sitting in my bed, typing on my laptop, when suddenly something unexpected caught my eye!
output.disgust: I was sitting in my bed, typing on my laptop, feeling repulsed by the mess around me.
